dialog.english:
��������Where are we? Did we get blown
away by the wind?
dialog.translation:
Dónde estamos? Nos arrastró
el viento?

dialog.english: Huh? There's a restaurant there.

Let's go check it out! Maybe we'll
discover something!
dialog.translation:
Vamos a verlo! Seguro que
encontramos algo!

dialog.english:
All right, I'll have the usual
shaved ice.
Me too!

All right, got it! Thank you for
your continued patronage!
dialog.translation:
Vale, marchando! Gracias
por venir siempre!

dialog.english: Hey, you! Go find more customers!
*sigh*
Hm?! Gomamon!
Gomamon!
Gabumon...? And Matt!
So does that mean Joe's here?

Yeah! He's over here! Come with
me!
Joe! So you were here!
Ah, well...

After everyone left, it was just
me and T.K...
dialog.translation:
Al irse todos, solo
quedamos T.K. y yo...

dialog.english:
Well, after we all split up, while
we were looking for food...
dialog.translation:
Bueno, tras separarnos,
mientras buscábamos comida...

dialog.english:
a Digimon who said he'd seen
humans led us astray.
dialog.translation:
un Digimon nos despistó
diciendo que vio humanos.

dialog.english: So that's what happened...

We wanted to come back, but we got
lost. And when we started getting
hungry, we found this place...
dialog.translation:
Queríamos volver, pero nos
perdimos. Cuando nos entró
hambre, hallamos este sitio...

dialog.english: So then, why are you working here?

"We only take dollars, not
Japanese yen! You have to work off
what you ate!" he said.
dialog.translation:
"Solo aceptamos dólares, no
yenes! Debes trabajar
lo que comiste!", dijo.

dialog.english:
So you're saying you *have* to
work here.
dialog.translation:
En serio tienes que
trabajar aquí?

dialog.english:
You're too slow! The customers are
waiting! Hurry up and get the food
out!
dialog.translation:
Eres muy lento! Los clientes
esperan! Rápido, saca
la comida ya!

dialog.english: Y-yes, sir!
Hm? Who're you?
I'm his friend.
Hmph! Whaddya want?

How much longer does he have to
work?

Well, it was originally supposed
to be only three days...
dialog.translation:
Bueno, al principio iban a ser
solo tres días...

dialog.english:
...but every time I mess up he
adds more, so it's around two
weeks now!
dialog.translation:
...pero cada vez que fallo
me pone más días, y ya van
casi dos semanas!

dialog.english:
He's terrible! I suffer losses due
to him, so I'm just having him
make it up!
dialog.translation:
Es un desastre! Pierdo dinero
por su culpa, así que le hago
compensarlo!

dialog.english:
What's going on, what's with all
the fighting?
dialog.translation:
Qué pasa, a qué viene
tanta pelea?

dialog.english: Mr. Digitamamon!

So you're the owner. This is my
friend. Hasn't he worked enough?
dialog.translation:
Así que es el dueño. Este es mi
amigo. No ha trabajado bastante?

dialog.english:
Don't make me laugh! Although if
you worked the debt off with him,
it'd be a different story...
dialog.translation:
No me hagas reír! Aunque si
tú también pagaras la deuda,
sería otra historia...

dialog.english: About that...

If you can't, you're getting in
the way of business.
dialog.translation:
Si no puedes, estorbas
al negocio.

dialog.english:
Am I gonna be stuck here for the
rest of my life?
dialog.translation:
Me voy a quedar aquí
para siempre?

dialog.english:
T.K's waiting for me, so I'll
be back. Wait for me.
dialog.translation:
T.K. me espera, así que
volveré. Espérame.

dialog.english: Huh? Then...!

Then, I'll help you work. Sound
good?
dialog.translation:
Entonces te ayudo. Te
parece bien?

dialog.english: Matt! I'm in your debt!
Oh? You're PicoDevimon...

I have a favor to ask of you. Of
course, I'll pay you handsomely.
dialog.translation:
Necesito pedirte un favor.
Claro, te pagaré muy bien.

dialog.english: So? What do you want me to do?
dialog.translation: Y bien? Qué quieres que haga?

dialog.english:
Nothing much, just something
easy...
dialog.translation:
Nada del otro mundo,
algo fácil...

dialog.english:
Wait! Where do you think you're
going?
dialog.translation:
Espera! A dónde te crees
que vas?

dialog.english: Where...?

You're going to come back and work
with him!
dialog.translation:
Vas a volver y trabajar
con él!

dialog.english:
Huh? What's with the turning heel
all of a sudden?
dialog.translation:
Eh? A qué viene darte
la vuelta así, de repente?

dialog.english:
So, you don't care about what'll
happen to your friend in the
meantime?
dialog.translation:
Entonces, no te importa lo
que le pase a tu amigo
mientras tanto?

dialog.english: What?!
What should we do, Matt?

Go see T.K, Matt. I'll be
fine.
dialog.translation:
Ve con T.K., Matt. Estaré
bien.

dialog.english: No, it's fine.

Aren't you worried about T.K?
Hurry up and go.
dialog.translation:
No te preocupa T.K.?
Ve ya, rápido.

dialog.english: I said it's fine, didn't I?
dialog.translation: Ya dije que estoy bien, no?

dialog.english: Did I say something to upset you?

(Joe's saying this because he's
worried about me, and yet I...)
dialog.translation:
(Joe dice esto porque está
preocupado por mí, pero yo...)

dialog.english: I'm sorry for yelling at you.
Matt...
Let's work hard, Joe.
We're with you, too!
Yeah. You're right...

Hey! You've gotten the order
wrong!
dialog.translation:
Eh! Te has equivocado
de pedido!

dialog.english: W-what? That's weird...
Ten more days!

I'm sorry. I won't mess up from
now on, I swear!
dialog.translation:
Lo siento. No fallaré
más, lo juro!

dialog.english:
(How long do I have to keep doing
this?! I promised T.K...)
dialog.translation:
(Hasta cuándo tendré que
seguir así? Prometí a T.K...)

dialog.english:
We're in a good position here.
Now, just one more thing...
dialog.translation:
Estamos en buena posición.
Ahora, una cosa más...

dialog.english:
Hey, are you still peeling
potatoes?

Ah, let me get them. I'm washing
this...
dialog.translation:
Ah, ya las traigo. Estoy
lavando esto...

dialog.english: Hurry up!
I-I know!

There, it's the perfect trick!
He'll fall right down!
dialog.translation:
Listo, el truco perfecto!
Se caerá seguro!

dialog.english: Here we go... huh?

Huh?! W-why? Well, whatever.
You'll see! I'm not done with you
yet!
dialog.translation:
Eh?! P-por qué? Bueno, da igual.
Ya verás! Aún no he
acabado contigo!

dialog.english: Sora...
It's fine...
What a beautiful sound.
Who are you?

I'm just a passing-by bat Digimon.
You seem like a pretty honest and
loyal person.
dialog.translation:
Solo soy un Digimon murciélago
de paso. Pareces una persona
muy honesta y leal.

dialog.english:
Sacrificing yourself for your
friends and all.
dialog.translation:
Sacrificarte por tus
amigos y todo eso.

dialog.english: You know about that?

Yes. But on the other hand, your
friend...
dialog.translation:
Sí. Pero por otro lado,
tu amigo...

dialog.english: Joe? What about Joe?
I hear he's messing up on purpose.
dialog.translation: Dicen que la lía a propósito.

dialog.english: What?

He's just afraid of being left
alone.
I doubt Joe would do that.
Hm... you're a pretty nice guy...
Joe... is doing it on purpose?

Please! Let me go pick up my
brother! I'll come back, I
promise!
dialog.translation:
Por favor! Déjame ir a
buscar a mi hermano!
Volveré, lo prometo!

dialog.english: Nope, nope.

Why? I *swear* I'll come back and
work!
dialog.translation:
Por qué? JURO que
volveré a trabajar!

dialog.english: Heeheehee...

Aaah! The dishes broke on their
own!
dialog.translation:
Aaah! Los platos se han
roto solos!

dialog.english:
What are you doing?
Both of you, you'll be working one
more week!
dialog.translation:
Qué estáis haciendo?
Los dos trabajaréis una
semana más!

dialog.english: Cut it out, Joe!

Y-you've got it wrong! I didn't
even touch the dishes! They fell
on their own!
dialog.translation:
T-te equivocas! Ni
siquiera toqué los platos!
Se cayeron solos!

dialog.english: Stop making excuses!
I'm telling the truth, Matt...
Mattooooo!
That voice? It can't be!
T.K!

Matt! It's so good to see you
again!
dialog.translation:
Matt! Qué alegría
verte de nuevo!

dialog.english: How did you...
I came here with Tai!
Tai...!
Hey!
So you're alive...

Think I'm gonna let myself kick
the bucket before you do?
dialog.translation:
Crees que me voy a morir
antes que tú?

dialog.english:
Tai... thanks for taking care
of T.K.
dialog.translation:
Tai... gracias por cuidar
de T.K.

dialog.english: Don't worry about it!

T.K, I'm sorry. I couldn't come
back for you like I promised.
dialog.translation:
T.K., lo siento. No pude
volver a por ti como prometí.

dialog.english:
It's okay, don't worry! We got to
see each other again in the end,
anyway!
dialog.translation:
No pasa nada, tranquilo!
Al final nos hemos vuelto
a ver, de todos modos!

dialog.english:
Anyway, it doesn't look like
there's anyone here, so let's make
a run for it!
dialog.translation:
Bueno, parece que no hay
nadie aquí, así que
aprovechemos para escapar!

dialog.english: Huh? Run away?

Yeah! Let's hurry up and go look
for our friends!
dialog.translation:
Sí! Vamos rápido a buscar
a nuestros amigos!

dialog.english:
I don't want to. I don't mind
escaping, but I'm not going with
Joe.
dialog.translation:
No quiero. No me importa
escapar, pero no pienso ir
con Joe.

dialog.english: What?!

If we go together, he'll just be a
nuisance.
dialog.translation:
Si vamos juntos, solo será
un estorbo.

dialog.english:
What're you saying? They're all
our friends!
dialog.translation:
Qué dices? Todos ellos son
nuestros amigos!

dialog.english:
What do you mean, friends? You're
just dragging everyone around!
dialog.translation:
Qué amigos ni qué nada? Solo
estás arrastrando a todos!

dialog.english:
I'm tired of this! Go do what you
like on your own!
dialog.translation:
Estoy harto de esto! Haz
lo que quieras tú solo!

dialog.english: Wh... what?

I'm going with T.K! Leave us
alone!
dialog.translation:
Me voy con T.K.! Dejadnos
en paz!

dialog.english:
What's wrong with you, Matt?
We're all friends, aren't we?
dialog.translation:
Qué te pasa, Matt?
Somos todos amigos, no?

dialog.english: Be quiet! Just come quietly!
You!

You wouldn't be thinking of a way
to escape from here, would you?
dialog.translation:
No estaréis pensando en escapar
de aquí, verdad?

dialog.english:
If you were doing that, that'd be
quite troublesome...
dialog.translation:
Si estuvierais haciendo eso,
sería un buen problema...

dialog.english:
Huh? That's the Digimon who said
he'd lead me to other humans!
dialog.translation:
Eh? Es el Digimon que dijo
que me llevaría a otros humanos!

dialog.english:
He's a bad Digimon who tried to
trick us!
dialog.translation:
Es un Digimon malo que
intentó engañarnos

dialog.english: What?!

Why, you! I won't forgive you for
that!

You're brave, trying to shirk your
debt like that and get away with
it...
dialog.translation:
Qué valiente, intentando
escaquearte de tu deuda
y salirte con la tuya...

dialog.english:
That debt should have been settled
a long time ago!
dialog.translation:
Esa deuda debería estar saldada
hace tiempo!

dialog.english:
Yes, you were very good workers.
Let me return your change.
dialog.translation:
Sí, sois buenos trabajadores. Os
devuelvo el cambio.

dialog.english: There! Gotcha!
Help meeeeee!
T.K!
Hahaha...

If you attack me, I cannot
guarantee that this child will
survive!
dialog.translation:
Si me atacáis, no puedo
garantizar que este niño
sobreviva!

dialog.english: Matt, help meeeeeee!

You coward! I can't forgive
this...
Aaaaaah!
Gh...
J...Joe!
Why?!

Up 'til now, you've been saying
that we were in this together.
dialog.translation:
Hasta ahora, decías que
estábamos juntos en esto.

dialog.english:
You've been putting up with me, so
it's my turn.
dialog.translation:
Me has aguantado, así que
me toca a mí.

dialog.english:
I... even after I said all those
horrible things. Joe... Joe!
dialog.translation:
Yo... después de decir esas
cosas horribles. Joe... Joe!

dialog.english: He's too strong. It's over.

No, that's not true, we'll figure
out a way!
dialog.translation:
No, eso no es cierto, algo
se nos ocurrirá!

dialog.english:
I still haven't forgotten my
friends. I believe in them, and in
our friendship!
dialog.translation:
Aún no he olvidado a mis
amigos. Creo en ellos, y en
nuestra amistad!

dialog.english: W-what?!

That's the power of Matt's
Crest.
dialog.translation:
Es el poder del Emblema
de Matt.

dialog.english:
Go, WereGarurumon! Don't hold
back, not for even a second!
dialog.translation:
Ve, WereGarurumon! No te
contengas ni un segundo!

dialog.english: Gwaaaaaaaaaah!
Huh? Digitamamon?
N-no way! Digitamamon!
Hurry, ruuuuuuuuun!
You saved Joe!

Joe... thank you for saving
T.K.
dialog.translation:
Joe... gracias por salvar
a T.K.

dialog.english:
It's fine. I was always the one
you were getting out of trouble,
anyway.
dialog.translation:
Tranquilo. Siempre fui yo
quien te sacaba de líos,
de todos modos.

dialog.english: And...
Huh?
I'm sorry.
Matt...

...so you're saying, if we don't
do something about this world,
it'll affect ours as well.
dialog.translation:
...o sea, que si no hacemos
algo con este mundo, también
afectará al nuestro.

dialog.english: Pretty mu... hm?
What?

A reaction! Our friends are around
here!
dialog.translation:
Hay una reacción! Amigos
están cerca!

dialog.english:
Mine, too! It's coming from this
way...
dialog.translation:
La mía igual! Viene por
aquí...

dialog.english: Mine's coming from that way.

Well, we'll split up into two
groups. I'll go with T.K.
dialog.translation:
Bueno, nos dividimos en dos
grupos. Yo voy con T.K.

dialog.english:
Okay, then. Joe, you'll come with
me.
dialog.translation:
Vale, pues. Joe, tú vienes
conmigo.

dialog.english:
But...if we can't meet up again,
what are we gonna do?
dialog.translation:
Pero... si no podemos vernos,
qué hacemos?

dialog.english:
In that case, we'll meet up at the
bottom of that mountain.
dialog.translation:
En ese caso, nos vemos al pie
de esa montaña.

dialog.english: Got it. Let's do that.

Hey...we *are* going to meet
again, right?
dialog.translation:
Oye... vamos a
volver a vernos, no?

dialog.english:
We'll meet again. Because we're
friends.
dialog.translation:
Nos volveremos a ver,
somos amigos.

dialog.english:
Yeah, we'll definitely see each
other again.
dialog.translation:
Sí, seguro que nos veremos
de nuevo.

dialog.english: You're right. We're friends.

I hear voices from inside. It
sounds pretty busy in there.
dialog.translation:
Oigo voces ahí dentro.
Parece que hay mucho jaleo.

dialog.english:
Let's go check out the restaurant
for now.
dialog.translation:
Vamos a ver ese restaurante
por ahora.

dialog.english:
I could have sworn I heard
T.K's voice earlier.
dialog.translation:
Juraría que antes oí
la voz de T.K.
